corrections.reason: In Acts 11:2, the Ge'ez word is 'ቢጹ' (his brethren/companions). Visually on the page, the vowel strokes on the right legs of 'ቢ' and 'ጹ' were misread as 'በጺ'.
The Ge'ez conjunction 'እንዘ' (while, translated 'ሳለሁ' in L31) is printed with the 6th-order 'እ', which was misread as 1st-order 'አ'.
In Acts 11:5, the Ge'ez participle is 'ወእኅዝ' (and held/bound by its four corners, rendered 'የተያዘ' in L04). The middle glyph 'ኅ' was visually confused with 'ት'.
The 1st-person plural perfective in Classical Ge'ez is 'ወቦእነ' (and we entered, rendered 'በገባነ ጊዜ' in L09) with 6th-order 'እ', which is clearly visible in the print.
